thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-84721 fired: inference-service/eu-dedicated 5xx-rate spike, customer impact detected (errors ~18% last 5m). Pager: @mike oncall-eng.

mike: seeing it, getting paged. Investigating queue backlog + worker errors.

sara: I'm nearby, can take handoff if you need to triage customer comms.

mike: thx - quick check: are the dedicated pools showing OOMs? logs show repeated 'runtime: kvcache checksum mismatch' in 3 pods.

jordan: I can look at model runtime side. On it, tailing logs now.

ops-bot: autoscaler attempted +2 nodes but scaled back due to pending image pull failures in eu-region.

emily: customer-rep FYI — we've got multiple support tickets for timeouts. ETA on mitigation?

mike: short term: I'll pause routing to that pool and route to fallback model variant in us-west. Can we do a quick route flip? :thinking_face:

sara: agree. mike, run the routing switch, i'll start batch drain on pods and draft a customer post. jordan, can you confirm whether KV cache rollback helps?

jordan: quick test: pushing a KV cache invalidation on one node removed the checksum errors, looks like corruption after a recent runtime patch. Suggest rollback to previous runtime build for eu-dedicated.

mike: executing emergency route rule now: `rdwctl routes update inference --region eu --fallback us-west-v2 --weight 100`

incident-bot: Route update acknowledged, change id r-34f2 applied. Traffic is shifting.

ops-bot: Noted: node pool scale blocked due to imagePullErrors (registry rate-limit). Working on temporary mirror.

sara: starting graceful drain: `kubectl evict --selector=app=inference,zone=eu-dedicated --grace-period=30` (monitoring queues).

mike: routing flip successful, error rate on eu-dedicated dropping from 18% -> 6% within 45s. Customer-facing timeouts should fall.

emily: updating customers: "We've detected elevated errors for EU inference traffic; we rerouted to a healthy fallback and are rolling back a runtime patch. Expect resolution in ~20-30m."

jordan: initiating runtime rollback on eu-dedicated: `deployctl rollback inference-runtime eu 2026-03-15-rc4` — rolling to 3/3 pods.

incident-bot: Deployment rollback triggered rback-778, pods recreating.

mike: can someone monitor latency on fallback? if cost spikes we need to alert product.

sara: monitoring. current tail latency on us-west-v2 is +40ms median, acceptable for now.

ops-bot: mirror image pulled from backup registry, autoscaler can now add nodes if needed.

jordan: rollback finished, running health checks. kvcache errors gone on restarted pods.

mike: great. I'll slowly switch traffic back once health stable. Plan: 10% every 2m.

emily: sending updated note to customers (short post + support ticket updates).

sara: handoff: i'll stay on until full traffic restored, then close the PD. mike, want to take ownership for postmortem?

mike: yep i'll own the postmortem and coordinate with runtime team. sara: you can close PD after final verification.

incident-bot: Pager PD-84721 acknowledged by @mike at 1799990012.

mike: final check: error rate back to baseline 0.8%, latency normalizing. Proceeding with staged failback.

sara: full traffic restored. continuing post-incident checklist (collect logs, timeline, revert notes).

emily: customers notified: most replied ok, one asked for SLA credit timeline. Logged.

mike: thanks team. Closing loop: PD-84721 will be resolved once postmortem is filed. Sara, you can close the PD after monitoring window (30m).

ops-bot: PD-84721 status: resolved pending manual close.

sara: closing PD in 30m if no regressions. :thumbsup:
